description: Retrieves an attachment file from esa with signed URLs. For supported images (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP) under 30MB, returns base64-encoded data. For other file types, larger images, or when forceSignedUrl is true, returns signed URLs.

forceSignedUrl.description: If true, always return signed URLs instead of base64-encoded images. Default is false.

teamName.description: Team name (required). Use esa_get_teams first to see available teams.

url.description: Attachment URL. Can be a full URL (https://files.esa.io/..., https://dl.esa.io/...) or a path (/uploads/...)

name: esa_get_attachment
title: Get attachment file from esa
